More trees and green shrubs appear as the camera pans.
A large, calm lake comes into view on the right side.

The water of the lake is very clear, showing rocks on the bottom.
The camera settles on a view of the vast, blue lake.

He looks down at the ground to ensure his footing.
The man stops talking for a moment and looks around.
He mentions having to either hike up or hug the shore.
He looks at the rocky slope to his left.
The man considers his path forward through the brush.
He looks back at the lake to evaluate the shoreline.
The man continues walking slowly, surveying the area.

The video ends with a shot of the rocky landscape and sky.
